entries.message: This update includes only update unwatched episodes when marking a season watched and reset develop identity after main releases.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tweak: This update includes only update unwatched episodes when marking a season watched and reset develop identity after main releases.
Tweak: Partially watched seasons update only the episodes that are still unwatched
Tweak: Existing watched episodes remain unchanged when completing a season
Tweak: Fully watched seasons retain the explicit Resync season action
Tweak: Develop builds display the released version alongside their cycle build number
Tweak: Main promotions restart local develop metadata at the released version and build 1
Tweak: Version-aware update checks ignore higher build counters from older release cycles
